description: This Kotlin source file defines a benchmarking suite for startup performance tests of an Android application. It includes tests for cold startup times and startup with UI interactions, utilizing AndroidX Benchmark libraries.

classes.name: StartupMacrobenchmark
classes.description: A class containing benchmark tests for app startup performance and UI interaction metrics.

methods.name: coldStartup
methods.description: Performs a cold startup benchmark test measuring startup time.

methods.name: startupAndScrollFrameTiming
methods.description: Performs a startup test combined with UI scrolling interactions and frame timing measurement.

methods.name: runBenchmarkOrSkip
methods.description: Executes a benchmark run, skipping if known device issues are detected.
